text_block_list.text:
The heated race came to an end. Unable to 
seize the victory, Winning Ticket showed 
hints of frustration.

Furthermore, she realized she was being 
overwhelmed by Narita Taishin's fierce, 
demonic running.

Managing to shake off her self-doubt, 
Winning Ticket fired herself up so that 
she wouldn't lose in the Nippon Derby.
